blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The British accent is not just one accent. It is many accents. RP is the classic "BBC" sound. It is clear and slow. Cockney is from East London. Scouse is from Liverpool. Geordie is from Newcastle. Even in one London office, you can hear many accents.

You do not need to understand every word. Listen for the key words. The other words are not so important. The context helps you. It fills in the gaps.

Sometimes you need help. That is okay. You can ask: "Sorry, could you repeat?" This is polite. It is not rude. Speaking slowly rarely offends people. It helps them. Your ears get better fast — faster than you think.

items.q: How many British accents are there?
items.why: "The British accent is not just one accent. It is many accents."

items.q: Where is Scouse from?
items.why: "Scouse is from Liverpool."

items.q: The text says you should listen for…
items.why: "Listen for the key words."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que pedir para repetir é educado, não rude — o autor discordaria disso.

items.q: "Your ears get better fast" suggests that…
options: you must learn every word first
items.why: Inferência: se os ouvidos melhoram rápido, a prática traz progresso.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar sobre o sotaque britânico. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! I am Sophie. Today I want to talk about the British accent. Many people think it is hard. But it is okay. You can learn.

The classic accent is RP. It is the "BBC" sound. It is clear and slow. This is a good accent for beginners. It is easy to hear. So do not worry too much.

Here is my first tip. Listen for the key words. You do not need every word. The other words come with practice. Little by little, your ears learn.

Here is my second tip. If you do not understand, just ask. Say: "Sorry, could you repeat?" This is polite. It is normal. Nobody is angry. In our London office, we ask this every day.

Speaking slowly is fine too. It is not rude. It helps everyone. So be calm, listen, and ask. Your English will grow. I promise. See you next time!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What accent does Sophie say is good for beginners?
items.why: "The classic accent is RP. It is the 'BBC' sound… This is a good accent for beginners."

items.q: What is Sophie's first tip?
items.why: "Listen for the key words. You do not need every word."

items.q: What can you say if you do not understand?
items.why: "Say: 'Sorry, could you repeat?' This is polite."

items.q: Sophie's tone in this talk is…
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "do not worry", "be calm", "I promise" — um tom gentil e encorajador.

items.q: Why does Sophie mention the London office?
options: to say the office is very big
to show that asking to repeat is normal
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "we ask this every day" para mostrar que pedir repetição é comum e normal.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She has a lovely British accent." An accent is…
options: the way you sound when you speak
items.why: Accent = sotaque, o jeito de soar quando você fala.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I like the ___ of her voice. It is soft and clear."
items.why: Sound = som; o som da voz.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please ___ slowly. Then I understand you."
items.why: Speak = falar.

items.q: "I listen to the podcast every morning." To listen means to…
items.why: Listen = ouvir, prestar atenção a um som.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sorry, I did not hear you. Can you ___ that, please?"
items.why: Repeat = repetir; pedir para dizer de novo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Sorry, I did not catch that." This means…
options: I did not hear or understand it
items.why: Catch that = pegar/entender o que foi dito; "não entendi".

items.q: "Can you speak up, please?" This means…
items.why: Speak up = falar mais alto.

items.q: "Please slow down a little." You want the person to…
items.why: Slow down = ir mais devagar, falar mais devagar.

items.q: "Sorry, could you say that again?" You are asking the person to…
items.why: Say that again = dizer de novo, repetir.

items.q: "Don't give up. Your English is getting better." To give up means to…
items.why: Give up = desistir; a frase pede para NÃO desistir.
